body:
A fix for this, with a test: **`davsync: a server that breaks on a conditional read is read without one (123pan, #4993)`** — head [`68e57a485`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/commit/68e57a485b87ff8b5220e5acb86d3d3443755314), branch [`fix/4993-webdav-conditional-get`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/fix/4993-webdav-conditional-get). ## What broke A sync after the first reads `magpie/magpie.magpie-backup` with the version last seen — `If-None-Match: ` (`internal/davsync/dav.go`, `dav.get`), so a file unchanged is answered 304 and costs a request, not a download. 123pan answers that GET `HTTP 500` instead (the reporter's curl: a plain GET 200 with the file, a HEAD 200 with a valid ETag, a GET with `If-None-Match` 500 about half a minute later), and `dav.get` failed every answer that wasn't 200/304/403/404/409. Since the ETag is kept in the sync state, every sync after went out with the condition again, 500 again — the sync never came back on its own. The same read without the conditions works, so the server breaks on the condition, not the read. ## The fix - A conditional read answered 5xx (429/503 are already the rate-limit path) is asked **again without the conditions**: the file comes whole, as it always did on a server without them, and the sync goes on. - The version it comes back with is marked `NoCondRead`, kept in the sync state, so no read of that server is sent with a condition again — one wasted round-trip, not one every sync. - The ETag stays: the write still goes over it with `If-Match`, so the check that keeps another computer's write from being gone over is kept, as the issue asks. The marking rides on the version a write leaves, too, so a sync that writes doesn't ask with a condition once more. - Writes are untouched: `If-Match` is the concurrent-write protection, and 123pan's behaviour on a conditional PUT isn't in the report — a write it refused would say `writing … HTTP 500`, its own case.
Patch, git am ready (68e57a485) — SHA-256 first 16: d587320e4f94d9bd ```patch From 68e57a485b87ff8b5220e5acb86d3d3443755314 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001 From: ggbdpq Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 02:36:51 +0800 Subject: [PATCH] davsync: a server that breaks on a conditional read is read without one (123pan, #4993) MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8 Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit A sync after the first reads the backup with the version last seen — If-None-Match, or If-Modified-Since on a server without ETags — and a server that says 304 for a file unchanged is spared the download. 123pan answers that GET 500 instead (the reporter's curl, 2026-11-03: a plain GET answers 200 with the file, a HEAD answers 200 with a valid ETag, a GET with If-None-Match answers 500 half a minute later), and the read failed on every sync after: the ETag is kept in the sync state, so the next read went out with the condition again, and 500 again. A conditional read answered 5xx is asked again without the conditions, and the version it comes back with is marked NoCondRead, so no read of that server is sent with a condition again — the file comes whole, as it always did on a server without them, and the ETag stays, for the write to go over: the check that keeps another computer's write from being gone over is kept. The marking rides on the version the write leaves too, so a sync that writes doesn't ask with a condition once more. TestDAV123panConditionalRead and TestSync123panConditionalRead are new; a failed read without conditions is failed as before. Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode) --- internal/davsync/123pan_test.go | 194 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ internal/davsync/dav.go | 40 ++++++- 2 files changed, 232 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-) create mode 100644 internal/davsync/123pan_test.go diff --git a/internal/davsync/123pan_test.go b/internal/davsync/123pan_test.go new file mode 100644 index 000000000..b3cfcbffd --- /dev/null +++ b/internal/davsync/123pan_test.go @@ -0,0 +1,194 @@ +package davsync + +import ( + "context" + "io" + "net/http" + "net/http/httptest" + "slices" + "strings" + "sync" + "testing" + + "github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/provider" +) + +// pan123DAV answers as 123pan's WebDAV plausibly does (#4993). The +// reporter saw, with curl (2026-11-03): a plain GET of the file answers +// 200 with its 1,910,440 bytes, a HEAD answers 200 with a valid ETag, and +// a GET sent with If-None-Match — the ETag the HEAD said — answers HTTP +// 500, about half a minute later. 304 never comes: the conditions aren't +// understood, they break the read. Writes weren't seen (the read fails +// first), so If-Match is taken to work. +type pan123DAV struct { + mu sync.Mutex + files map[string][]byte + etags map[string]string + dirs map[string]bool + n int + // condGets are the GETs that came with a condition, plainGets those + // that came without; puts the writes + condGets, plainGets, puts int +} + +func newPan123DAV() *pan123DAV { + return &pan123DAV{files: map[string][]byte{}, etags: map[string]string{}, dirs: map[string]bool{"/dav": true}} +} + +func (p *pan123DAV) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { + p.mu.Lock() + defer p.mu.Unlock() + if u, pw, ok := r.BasicAuth(); !ok || u != "me" || pw != "pw" { + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnauthorized) + return + } + switch r.Method { + case http.MethodGet: + if r.Header.Get("If-None-Match") != "" || r.Header.Get("If-Modified-Since") != "" { + p.condGets++ + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError) + return + } + p.plainGets++ + b, ok := p.files[r.URL.Path] + if !ok { + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound) + return + } + w.Header().Set("ETag", p.etags[r.URL.Path]) + w.Write(b) + case http.MethodPut: + if !p.dirs[urlDir(r.URL.Path)] { + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict) + return + } + b, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body) + p.puts++ + p.n++ + p.files[r.URL.Path], p.etags[r.URL.Path] = b, `"`+strings.Repeat("e", p.n)+`"` + w.Header().Set("ETag", p.etags[r.URL.Path]) + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated) + case "MKCOL": + dir := strings.TrimSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/") + if p.dirs[dir] { + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed) + return + } + p.dirs[dir] = true + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated) + default: + w.WriteHeader(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed) + } +} + +// A read sent with the version last seen is answered 500 by 123pan, not +// 304: the read is asked again without the conditions, and the version is +// marked so no condition is sent to that server again — the ETag stays, +// for the write to go over (#4993). +func TestDAV123panConditionalRead(t *testing.T) { + fake := newPan123DAV() + srv := httptest.NewServer(fake) + defer srv.Close() + d, err := newDAV(Config{URL: srv.URL + "/dav/", User: "me", Password: "pw"}) + if err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + ctx := context.Background() + if _, err := d.put(ctx, []byte("v1"), ""); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + etag := fake.etags["/dav/magpie/magpie.magpie-backup"] + + // the read with the version last seen: answered 500, asked again + // without the conditions, and said so in the version it gives back + data, v, err := d.get(ctx, version{ETag: etag}) + if err != nil { + t.Fatalf("a read 123pan answers 500: %v", err) + } + if string(data) != "v1" { + t.Fatalf("read %q, want v1", data) + } + if !v.NoCondRead || v.ETag != etag { + t.Fatalf("version %+v, want the ETag kept and no conditional reads from here on", v) + } + if fake.condGets != 1 || fake.plainGets != 1 { + t.Fatalf("%d conditional GETs, %d plain: want one of each — the 500, then the read without the conditions", fake.condGets, fake.plainGets) + } + + // the version marked: no condition is sent again + fake.condGets, fake.plainGets = 0, 0 + if _, _, err := d.get(ctx, v); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if fake.condGets != 0 || fake.plainGets != 1 { + t.Fatalf("%d conditional GETs, %d plain after the marking: want no conditions sent", fake.condGets, fake.plainGets) + } + + // the write after the read goes over the ETag, and the version it + // leaves keeps the marking + v2, err := d.put(ctx, []byte("v2"), v.ETag) + if err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if !v2.NoCondRead { + t.Fatal("the version after the write lost the marking: the next sync would ask with the conditions again") + } +} + +// 123pan breaks a sync that reads with the version last seen: the first +// sync reads the file and writes, and every sync after reads with +// If-None-Match, is answered 500, and fails. The read is asked again +// without the conditions, once, and the syncs go through (#4993). +func TestSync123panConditionalRead(t *testing.T) { + fake := newPan123DAV() + srv := httptest.NewServer(fake) + defer srv.Close() + ctx := context.Background() + a := newComputer(t) + a.use(t) + provider.Save(provider.Provider{ID: "deepseek", Name: "DeepSeek", Chat: "https://api.deepseek.com/v1", Key: "k1"}) + if err := Configure(Config{URL: srv.URL + "/dav/", User: "me", Password: "pw", Passphrase: "correct horse", Keys: true}); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if err := Now(ctx); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + + // the first sync read without the conditions; the next reads with the + // ETag, is answered 500, and asks again without them + if err := Now(ctx); err != nil { + t.Fatalf("the sync after the first: %v", err) + } + if fake.condGets != 1 { + t.Fatalf("%d conditional GETs after the second sync, want 1: the one answered 500", fake.condGets) + } + + // from here the conditions are not sent: the sync reads plainly + condGets, plainGets := fake.condGets, fake.plainGets + if err := Now(ctx); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if fake.condGets != condGets || fake.plainGets != plainGets+1 { + t.Fatalf("%d conditional GETs, %d plain after the third sync: want the conditions gone for good", fake.condGets, fake.plainGets) + } + + // changed here, the merge still goes up, over the ETag + provider.Save(provider.Provider{ID: "kimi", Name: "Kimi", Chat: "https://api.moonshot.cn/v1", Key: "k2"}) + if err := Now(ctx); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if fake.puts != 2 { + t.Fatalf("%d writes, want 2: the first sync's and the merged one", fake.puts) + } + b := newComputer(t) + b.use(t) + if err := Configure(Config{URL: srv.URL + "/dav/", User: "me", Password: "pw", Passphrase: "correct horse", Keys: true}); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if err := Now(ctx); err != nil { + t.Fatal(err) + } + if got := ids(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"deepseek=k1", "kimi=k2"}) { + t.Fatalf("b after joining: %v", got) + } +} diff --git a/internal/davsync/dav.go b/internal/davsync/dav.go index 5ab0c4601..424bed8f4 100644 --- a/internal/davsync/dav.go +++ b/internal/davsync/dav.go @@ -43,10 +43,20 @@ type version struct { // refused): another computer's write in the moment between may have // gone over it (#1776) Blind bool `json:"-"` + // NoCondRead: the server breaks on conditional reads — 123pan answers + // a GET sent with If-None-Match 500 (#4993) — so no read asks it with + // one again; the ETag stays, for the write to go over + NoCondRead bool `json:"noCondRead,omitempty"` } // conditions are the headers that ask for the file only when it isn't v. +// None for a server that breaks on conditional reads: it was asked with +// one once and said 500 (123pan, #4993), so it never is again — the ETag +// stays, for the write to go over. func (v version) conditions() map[string]string { + if v.NoCondRead { + return nil + } switch { case v.ETag != "": return map[string]string{"If-None-Match": v.ETag} @@ -139,6 +149,10 @@ type dav struct { base *url.URL user, pass string client *http.Client + // noCondRead: this server was asked with a condition once and broke + // on it (#4993), so no read of it is sent with one again, this run — + // and the version says so, for the runs after + noCondRead bool } func newDAV(c Config) (*dav, error) { @@ -269,6 +283,9 @@ func (d *dav) there(ctx context.Context, u string) bool { // W/"…"; either never matches the file in an If-Match, so every write after // such a read was refused as changed meanwhile (#1362). func (d *dav) get(ctx context.Context, have version) (data []byte, v version, err error) { + if have.NoCondRead { + d.noCondRead = true + } cond := have.conditions() h := map[string]string{"Accept-Encoding": "identity"} for k, v := range cond { @@ -278,6 +295,23 @@ func (d *dav) get(ctx context.Context, have version) (data []byte, v version, er if err != nil { return nil, version{}, err } + // A server that breaks on a conditional read — 123pan answers a GET + // sent with If-None-Match 500, half a minute later, where a file + // unchanged was to be answered 304 (#4993) — is asked again without + // the conditions: the file comes as it always did, costing a + // download, and the version is marked, so no read of this server is + // sent with a condition again. A read without conditions that fails + // all the same is a server trouble of its own, said as it is. + if cond != nil && res.StatusCode >= 500 { + res.Body.Close() + d.noCondRead = true + data, v, err = d.get(ctx, version{ETag: have.ETag, Modified: have.Modified, NoCondRead: true}) + if err != nil { + return nil, version{}, err + } + v.NoCondRead = true + return data, v, nil + } defer res.Body.Close() if res.StatusCode == http.StatusNotModified && cond != nil { return nil, have, errNotModified @@ -359,8 +393,10 @@ func (d *dav) put(ctx context.Context, data []byte, etag string) (version, error return version{}, cerr } // an ETag said here is the version written; with none, the - // next sync reads the file in full, as before - return version{ETag: res.Header.Get("ETag")}, nil + // next sync reads the file in full, as before. noCondRead + // rides along: it is the server's, not the version's, and the + // write's version is the one the next sync reads with + return version{ETag: res.Header.Get("ETag"), NoCondRead: d.noCondRead}, nil case res.StatusCode == http.StatusPreconditionFailed: return version{}, errChanged case res.StatusCode == http.StatusForbidden && (try > 0 || d.there(ctx, d.url(folder)+"/")): -- 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155) ```
## Verification | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | New `TestDAV123panConditionalRead` / `TestSync123panConditionalRead`, fix reverted (ablation) | red — the read fails `reading magpie.magpie-backup from the WebDAV server: HTTP 500`, the reporter's message | | The two with the fix | green — the read is asked again without the conditions, and the syncs after send no condition | | `go test -tags nogui ./internal/davsync/` | ok (35s) | | The two under `-race` | ok | | `go test -tags nogui ./internal/cli/` | one fail, `TestEveryRouteHasACommandOrIsNamed` — fails on `upstream/main` too (known pre-existing) | | `gofmt -l internal/davsync/`, `go vet ./internal/davsync/ ./internal/cli/ ./internal/gui/`, `go build ./...` | clean (vet's two cgo warnings in `internal/gui` are pre-existing) | Ablation: `dav.go` reverted to the base (`7785c4278`) with the test kept — build failed on the marking the test reads, and with the fix back the suite is green. Conditions elsewhere are left alone on purpose: `s3.go` (a signed S3 request, its own HEAD-then-PUT design), `library/skillcheck.go` and the GitHub backend (the GitHub API honours the conditions), `gui/web.go` (magpie is the server there). `If-Modified-Since` is covered by the same fallback, since the retry carries no condition at all.
